# Specific Full URLs from the Sep 2021 – Jul 2022 Window

Here is a curated list of **10 specific, full URL paths** live during the user's tenure window (September 2021 to July 2022) on `get-carrot.com`. You can plug any of these exact URLs into the Wayback Machine search bar (or CDX API) at `https://web.archive.org/web/*/ [URL]` to view the archived Webflow snapshots and page source code:

---

### **Demand-Gen & Lead Capture Pages**
1. **B2B Contact / Demo Request Page**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/contact`  
   *(The primary demand generation landing page for employer demo requests and sales inquiries)*

2. **Employer Solutions Landing Page**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/employers`  
   *(Main enterprise buyer landing page detailing fertility benefit plan design and ROI)*

3. **Health Plans & Partners Landing Page**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/health-plans`  
   *(Targeted partner solution page for health insurance plans and health systems)*

---

### **Gated Research Reports & Resource Landing Pages**
4. **"Fertility at Work 2021" Research Report**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/resources/fertility-at-work-2021`  
   *(Gated whitepaper download landing page released in mid-2021)*

5. **"Menopause in the Workplace 2022" Research Report**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/resources/menopause-in-the-workplace-2022`  
   *(Flagship 2022 demand-gen research report landing page)*

6. **Resource Center Hub**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/resources`  
   *(Central Webflow CMS collection hub for downloadable guides, webinars, and case studies)*

---

### **Blog & Member Intent Landing Pages**
7. **High-Intent Employee Resource Post**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/blog/how-to-ask-your-employer-for-fertility-benefits`  
   *(High-converting blog article targeting employees seeking employer-sponsored coverage)*

8. **Member Experience Overview**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/members`  
   *(Member landing page covering care navigation, Carrot Card® financial tools, and at-home testing)*

---

### **Corporate & Employer Brand Pages**
9. **Company & Leadership Page**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/about`  
   *(Corporate mission, executive team, and clinical advisory board)*

10. **Careers & Employer Branding**:  
   `https://www.get-carrot.com/careers`  
   *(Recruitment and team growth landing page)*

---

### **Archive.org Quick Lookup Format**
To inspect any of these snapshots directly on Wayback Machine, format the URL as:  
`https://web.archive.org/web/20220101000000*/https://www.get-carrot.com/contact`  
or use CDX API query:  
`http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=https://www.get-carrot.com/contact&output=json&from=20210901&to=20220731`
